scientific_integrity: Finite exact tests are supplementary; arbitrary-size result is proved analytically. Formula uses original unweighted complete multipartite graph and does not claim independence or negative association of arbitrary events.
scientific_limitations: Full negative association not proved; only inclusion-event log-submodularity and its corollaries.
No extension claimed for weighted spanning trees or arbitrary graphs.
Some earlier degree-enumeration papers were accessible only via summaries/abstracts; historical priority is qualified.
title: Log-submodular leaf inclusion in uniform complete-multipartite spanning trees
